scope: All new/changed UTF-8 files; earlier dated files and licenses untouched.
review: Each file reviewed for private identifiers, account data, private URLs, private absolute paths, credentials, raw UI, hidden reasoning and unrelated material. Pattern scan supplements review.
excluded: Full operational prompt and private original PATH
checks: Exact selected quotes match original visible text
Original artifacts hashed; log PATH redaction documented
Independent static artifact audit; no shell script rerun
JSON parse, relative links, changed-file checksum coverage
